description: A refined contemporary hotel-style bedroom vignette photographed at standing eye-level, framing the right side of the bed and the bedside wall. The lower portion of the wall is paneled in medium walnut wood planking running horizontally, creating a warm band of natural wood grain texture. A narrow horizontal slot at the transition between the fabric and wood panels glows with a continuous warm amber indirect light, tracing a clean luminous line across the full width of the wall. A floating wall-mounted nightstand in light oak with a single flush drawer hangs on the wood panel section, holding two stacked softcover books. Above the nightstand, a white square reading light is mounted flush to the wall, directing a focused spot of warm amber light downward onto the nightstand surface. Power outlets are mounted adjacent. To the right, the cream white leather or leatherette upholstered headboard with a square-tufted button pattern rises firmly. The bed is dressed in cream linen with a warm grey throw draped casually across the foot. Full-length linen curtains in warm sand tone hang on the far left, softly filtering light. The floor is wide-plank warm oak. The palette is cream, warm putty-sand, medium walnut, warm amber, soft grey.
